rows.my_view: Expensive but watchlist-worthy at $375, with a bear $205 / base $370 / bull $585 range.
rows.committee: The price sits ~1% above your own $370 base with zero cushion, so your own conservative buy rule points to pass-at-this-price, not a hopeful watchlist.

rows.my_view: Growth is decelerating (473% to 34% to 32%) and the population-ceiling risk is real.
rows.committee: The Y/Y read overstates saturation since Q1's $116.4M runs ~20% above FY25's quarterly pace, but with no disclosed DEB penetration the ceiling stays genuinely unresolved.

rows.my_view: Exceptional at 93% gross / 57% FCF and they must stay exceptional.
rows.committee: We agree the margins are elite and clean; the only real threat is a payer clawback dropping gross margin below ~90%.

rows.my_view: Real but may be one-product, protected by regulatory lock-in and switching costs.
rows.committee: The moat is genuine but narrow, bounded to a few-thousand-patient market and unproven beyond VYJUVEK, so the market inside it can saturate even as the wall holds.

rows.my_view: Reinvesting the cash intelligently into a second product is the open question.
rows.committee: Firepower is bigger than you assumed (~$814M, not $492M), and the paid-for reusable factory helps, but 19% ROE on 54% net margins says cash is outrunning reinvestment opportunity.

rows.my_view: One product at a platform valuation, exposed to concentration and payer risk.
rows.committee: Agreed exactly: this is one great drug priced as a compounder, and the annuity multiple re-rates to $205 if the platform never converts.

rows.my_view: Concentration, payer, and pipeline risk are the things you're watching.
rows.committee: You treat redosing purely as recurring revenue, but a lifelong weekly gel only earns if patients keep dosing, and no persistence or adherence data exists in the packet to confirm the annuity doesn't leak.

rows.my_view: The Aug 3 call for pipeline naming and penetration disclosure.
rows.committee: The one deciding datapoint is Aug 3 Y/Y growth plus whether management names a dosed, distinct-tissue second program with a readout timeline; silence is the loudest possible tell.

confidence.label: High
confidence.why: The business quality is confirmed with hard numbers and the risks are unusually legible with a clean dated catalyst, though the two thesis-deciding facts remain absent.

final_verdict: Elite business at the wrong price with two decisive facts still missing; watchlist is earned, but your own rules lean closer to pass-at-this-price than a hopeful hold.
